title: Our New House Keeps Getting TALLER 🏠
description:
In this town, when your ceiling rises, don't look up. Something taller than you moved in. Houses grow to fit the tallest one living in them, and a tall guest's hat can lift the dining room ceiling.

Our old house was always a ladder taller than any of us. It sold in the spring, and Mom hasn't laughed since. The new one fits me exactly, until the morning there's a gap over my head.

It's made up. A creepy blocky story, built with code and Blender.
pin: Comment UP if you would have looked.
